messages:
harper: Quick alignment thread: I'm proposing a thin taxonomy for Private deploys that productizes install friction vs guarantees. Names: fast-relay, nat-pin, peer-sovereign. Keep installer small; surface guarantees via manifest/contract.

harper: Key constraint: upgrades must be per-tenant opt-in with an auditable manifest stream + single-click revert. Field needs a signed preflight artifact for air-gapped installs.

zain: Agree. For nat-pin we need a concrete lease model: lease_id in manifest and a default pin_window (7d). If we allocate pool, include a compensatory clause in SLA.

olivia: Operational checklist: preflight must validate control-plane reachability, route propagation, NAT translation test, DNS resolution, and KMS handshake (if external). Failures should include exact remediation steps. Preflight output = preflight-report.json + signature.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PRD-7100 "Private presets + manifest contract" -> https://go/repo/PRD-7100 :spiral_note:

matt: Console UX: show manifest hash, last applied, pending diff, and a revert CTA. Also surface the "contract card" customers accepted during onboarding so field can see what guarantees are in force.

harper: Launch gates I propose:
- Gate 0: fast-relay GA (preflight smoke + revert UI + 2 pilots)
- Gate 1: nat-pin Beta (pin API + pin expiry UI + ip-stability tests)
- Gate 2: peer-sovereign Field (signed manifest flow + route-filter checklist + legal sign-off)

zain: Owners: preflight & signed report -> olivia; pin API + lease logic -> zain; console + revert UX -> matt; runbooks + pilot outreach -> harper.

olivia: I'll produce the preflight schema and a deterministic report format; will include a small troubleshooting blurb per failure code. For airgap: we sign the report and verify customer signature before manifest apply.

matt: I'll mock the manifest-diff and revert flow; add an audit event for each revert and attach the preflight-report to the revert job.

harper: Acceptance criteria for Gate 1 (nat-pin Beta): egress ip stable for pin_window in 3 test topologies, preflight-report produced and signed in airgap flow, console shows pin expiry and lease_id, and automated revert job works in canary.

ops-bot: PRD-7100 labels updated: +private-deploy +egress-sla +due 2026-06-12

harper: Action items:
- olivia: preflight schema + signed-report (owner)
- zain: pin API + lease model (owner)
- matt: manifest-diff/revert UI + audit (owner)
- harper: docs + pilot invites (owner)

harper: Please react :thumbsup: to lock or reply with objections.

zain: :+1:

matt: :+1:

olivia: :+1: will post schema draft tomorrow

harper: Thanks 44d filing RFC after lunch.
